answer: Registration binds each identity to a 500-unit stake, a one-per-device credential hashed into a shared mirror ledger, and a proof-of-work thread logged once per device. Forging N fakes locks 500N units, risks 100 percent slashing per epoch, and must wait 30 epochs to withdraw. Each copied credential forfeits the shared bond, so marginal cost per fake stays at 500 units, and independent jurors detect pigment reuse.
